i: e/i — and (variant of e before some sounds) · also i — there, therein (adverb, Latin ibi, like French y; meted i las fedes, 'put your pledged faith into it')
mio: mio — my (unstressed possessive; mio Çid 'my lord Cid')
çid: Çid — the Cid, 'lord' (Arabic sīdī 'my lord'; pronounced Tsid)
que: que — that, who, which; for · also por que — because, since (= porque) · por que — by which, whereby (por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more')
fo: seer (and ir, which shares this preterite) — he/it was; went (preterite 3rd sg.; = fue, restored by Pidal as f[o]; of this part's three occurrences, fo entrado and fo acusado are periphrastic/passive ser + past part. constructions, while fo algo is a plain copula with a pronoun predicate, 'was something') · also commo fo tu voluntad, ca fo tu voluntad 'as/for it was your will' (ser + noun subject, 'it was'; Pidal restores f[o])
de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por)
noch: noche — night (apocopated form of noche; cf. anoch)
un: uno — a, one (apocopated masc. before a noun)
priso: prender — he took (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = prendió, tomó)
bien: bien — well · bien — good, benefit (noun; algún bien vos pueda far 'some good I may do you')
a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight'
vino: vino — wine (noun); also venir — he came (strong preterite 3rd sg.; por en vino a aquesto, 'that is how he came to this pass')
en: en — in, into, on · en — of it, thence (= ende; por en avemos qué fablar 'of which we have to speak')
campeador: Campeador — the Battler, the Champion (the Cid's epithet, from campo 'field of battle')
ca: ca — for, because (Latin quia) · ca — perhaps 'but, whereas' (el uno es en paradiso, ca el otro non entró allá; the sense is uncertain)
mientra: mientra — while, as long as (= mientras)
lo: lo — him, it (object pronoun) · lo que perdedes 'that which you lose' (neuter antecedent of the relative)
era: seer — it was (imperfect of seer = ser)
pagado: pagar — satisfied, pleased; also paid (past part.; será pagado = 'he will be content with')
otro: otro — other, another (masc.; el otro 'the other'; = otro)
mañana: mañana — morning (a la mañana 'in the morning'; otro dia mañana 'next morning'; = mañana)
pienssan: pensar — they think; pensar de + inf. 'to set about (doing)' (epic formula)
es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida)
plazo: plazo — term, time limit (spelling without d; = plazo)
sepades: saber — you know; sepades que 'be aware that' (present subjunctive 2nd pl., as a command; = sepáis)
más: más — more; e más 'and moreover' · non más 'no more, nothing more'; por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more'
ellos: ellos — they, them (stressed 3rd pl. masc. pronoun)
posar: posar — to lodge, halt for the night (infinitive; = posar)
las: el/la — the (fem. pl.); them (fem. object pronoun)
moros: moro — Moor (masc. pl.); a moros nin a cristianos, 'to any living soul' (merism)
han: aver — they have (present 3rd pl.; = han); after an infinitive, the auxiliary of a split future (seervos han = os serán)
aun: aun — even, besides · also aun — yet, still (aun vea el dia 'may I yet see the day')
veer: veer — to see (= ver; two syllables)
yentes: yente — people, folk (= gente; y- from Latin g-)
e: e — and (= modern y) · also aver — I have (1st sg. present, apocopated form of he, perfect auxiliary: Espeso e el oro, 'I have spent the gold')
pendones: pendón — pennon, lance-banner (men are counted by lances)
vos: vos — you (object pronoun, polite/plural) · also subject 'you' (vos, que por mí dexades 'you who leave for my sake'); dative 'to you' (dar vos quiero vuestra part)
qui: qui — he who, whoever (old relative pronoun, Latin qui; = quien)
quisiere: querer — shall wish (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quisiere)
no: no — not (variant spelling of non) · also nos — to us (nos elided before lo: no' lo, 'to us it')
tierra: tierra — land, country; one's own land · earth (fezist çielo e tierra 'you made heaven and earth'; por tierra 'on earth')
quitar: quitar — to leave, quit (infinitive; el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'; = quitar, closest abandonar)
nos: nos — we (subject pronoun; = nosotros) · also nos — us, to us (object pronoun; atorgar nos hedes 'you will grant us') · also reflexive 'ourselves' (nos partimos 'we part'); dative (la missa nos dirá 'will say for us')
man: man — morning (the short form, from Latin mane; = mañana)
por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid)
ayuso: ayuso — down, downward (adverb, Latin deorsum; no modern equivalent, closest abajo)
andar: andar — to travel, go on (infinitive; = andar)
medio: medio — middle; en medio de 'in the middle of'
d: de — of, with (elided form of de before a vowel, d'arena = de arena) · de — from (unos d'otros 'one from another')
dar: dar — to give (infinitive; split future dar gelos [hemos] = se los daremos)
commo: commo — as, like (spelling variant of como) · how, that, in the way that (commo sirva a doña Ximena 'how he is to serve doña Ximena'); like (commo la uña de la carne)
querié: querer — it was about to (imperfect 3rd sg., -ié ending; la noch querié entrar 'night was about to fall'; = quería)
an: aver — they have (3rd pl. present of aver = han) · perfect auxiliary (passados los an 'they have passed'; la missa acabada la an 'they have finished'); an por troçir 'there remain to pass'; an ... ha far 'they have to do, are to do'
mandado: mandado — message, news, word (noun; from mandar 'to send, order')
so: so/su — his, her, its (unstressed possessive sg.; so çervicio = su servicio); also seer — I am (1st sg. present; = soy; so ayrado, 'I am in [the king's] ira')
todo: todo — all, every (de todo conducho, 'with every kind of provision')
far: far — to do (apocopated infinitive of fazer; = hacer)
faze: fazer — is done, is made (present 3rd sg.; = hace)
vagar: vagar — leisure, slowness (noun; de vagar 'at leisure, unhurriedly'; = vagar, closest despacio)
o: o — or; also ó — where (interrogative, Latin ubi; ¿O sodes…? 'Where are you…?')
dizen: dezir — they say, they call (present 3rd pl.; do dizen monte Calvarie 'where they call (it) Mount Calvary'; = dicen)
sobre: sobre — upon, over; here 'on the security of' (sobre aquellas arcas) · sobre Navas de Palos 'above, hard by Navas de Palos' (position along the route)
minaya: Minaya — the title by which the Cid's kinsman Álvar Fáñez is called, usually explained as mi + anaya 'my brother'
ya: ya — O! (vocative particle, Arabic yā); also 'now, already'
ora: hora — hour (= hora); en buen ora, part of the poem's honorific birth-formula, 'born in a good hour' · al ora 'at that very hour, then' (en ti crovo al ora)
çinxiestes: çeñir — you girded (strong preterite 2nd pl. of çeñir; Latin cinxistis)
fincaredes: fincar — you will remain, stay (future 2nd pl.; = quedaréis)
dedes: dar — you may give (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = deis)
dixo: dezir — he/she said (strong preterite; x = sh-sound; = dijo)
lança: lança — lance (= lanza); ardida lança, 'bold lance', stands for the bold man who wields it
nada: nada — nothing; por nada 'for anything (in the world)'
don: don — don, lord (honorific title) · also don — gift (noun; en don 'as a gift')
si: si — if; si + subjunctive alone = 'if only …!'
fore: seer — it may be (future subjunctive 3rd sg. of ser; = fuere)
al: a + el — to the; al menos 'even the least'
qué: qué — what a …! (exclamative) · also qué — what? which? (interrogative pronoun/adjective, as in de qué será pagado, 'with what will he be satisfied') · indirect: que non sabe qué se far '(so that) she knows not what to do'; avemos qué fablar 'we have something to speak of'
abiertas: abierto — open (fem. pl.; past part. of abrir)
quantos: quanto — as many as (masc. pl.; todos quantos 'all who'; = cuantos)
ovieron: aver — they had, they got (strong preterite of aver; = hubieron)
mano: mano — hand (sg.); en vuestra mano = 'in your keeping'
y: y — and (rarer spelling of e) · also y — there (adverb, = i, Latin ibi; entraré y 'I shall enter there')
sos: so — his, her, their (= modern sus)
afevos: afevos — behold, here is/are (presentative, a + fe + vos; = he aquí, ahí tenéis)
fasta: fasta — until, as far as (= hasta)
aver: aver — wealth, property, goods (noun use of aver, beside aver the verb 'to have')
tornan: tornar — they turn, go back (present 3rd pl.; tornan de castigar 'they go back to instructing'; = tornan)
castiello: castiello — castle (= castillo; here the castle quarter of Burgos)
poder: poder — to be able (infinitive; first half of a split future, poder nos han alcançar 'they will be able to overtake us'; = poder)
abiertos: abierto — open (masc. pl.; past part. of abrir)
venides: venir — you come (2nd pl. present, old -des ending; = venís)
do: do — where, as (relative adverb, Latin de ubi; = donde)
sea: seer — may be, that is (present subjunctive 3rd sg.)
dovos: dar + vos — I give you (present 1st sg. do + enclitic vos; = os doy)
